[[File:Desolate.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The ''Desolate'']]
The '''''Desolate''''' was a massive biologically engineered [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the dimension of [[Otherspace]]. It was captained by [[Ber'asco]] and contained many different rooms spread over four different platforms, including: the [[altar of death]], [[chamber of armor]], [[chamber of nutrients]], [[chamber of sleep]], [[growing chamber]], and [[Hall of Contests]]. Used by the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]], it was amorphous and over 450 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long. At both ends of the ship were caps of mysterious light, while the ship was controlled by a large brain located at its top. After the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] was linked to the main [[Computer/Legends|computer]], the ship was able to [[Lightspeed/Legends|jump]] to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], but it crashed into [[Stronghold (planet)|Stronghold]]. The ship was destroyed, though 200 Charon [[bioscientist]]s and [[Warrior (Charon)|warriors]] survived.
